messages:
maria: heads up — saw a ~3x spike in billing events for org:redwood-analytics around 08:12 UTC. invoice lines doubled, console shows duplicated line items. looks correlated with last router deploy v2.3.1 :eyes:
aj: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/insights?org=redwood-analytics — saw the same. any quick wins?
kevin: any logs? which field is being used for fingerprinting right now?
maria: digging, attaching a couple raw ingest logs: 
```
2025-04-01T08:11:59Z INFO ingest received event id=evt_01 req_id=req_abc client=redwood-analytics route_tag=route-a fingerprint=sha1(req_abc)
2025-04-01T08:12:01Z INFO ingest received event id=evt_02 req_id=req_abc client=redwood-analytics route_tag=route-b fingerprint=sha1(req_abc)
```
kevin: ah — fingerprint is just req_id. router started adding a route_tag header for per-tenant routing last night. same req_id hitting different backends now yields identical fingerprint -> aggregator treats them as dedupe candidates but different content gets coalesced incorrectly into invoice lines.
aj: so duplicates are from both 1) different route_tag values for same req and 2) aggregator window too narrow to see ordering? :thinking_face: 
sarah: quick idea: include route_tag + client_id + prompt_hash in fingerprint. small change and backfill missing tags.
devon: cautious: changing fingerprint shape is a migration. aggregator shards by fingerprint, so changing it will change partitioning and might create tiny duplicates during rollout. we need a compatibility path.
kevin: proposed approach: add event field `route_tag_hash` at ingress (non-breaking), stop relying on implicit req-only fingerprint, then switch aggregator to prefer composite fingerprint: `sha1(route_tag_hash + "|" + client_id + "|" + prompt_hash[:16])`. fallback to legacy if route_tag_hash is absent. rollout in three steps.
maria: pasted patch idea:
```
# current
def fingerprint(evt):
    return sha1(evt["req_id"]).hexdigest()

# new (backwards-compatible)
def fingerprint(evt):
    if evt.get("route_tag_hash"):
        key = evt["route_tag_hash"] + "|" + evt["client_id"] + "|" + evt.get("prompt_hash","")[:16]
    else:
        key = evt["req_id"]
    return sha1(key.encode()).hexdigest()
```
aj: nice. telemetry-wise we should emit `billing.dup_rate_by_route_tag` + `billing.dup_rate_legacy` so we can see switch impact. also add a dashboard row for route_tag in invoice debug view.
devon: also consider dedupe window: we currently use 30s. if route-tag switching creates out-of-order arrivals between replicas, maybe bump to 60s during rollout, then reduce once stable. but increasing window increases memory of aggregator. tradeoff.
kevin: agree on telemetry and staged rollout:
1) ingress: start writing `route_tag_hash` (canary in EU-W)
2) aggregator: read `route_tag_hash` with fallback, but leave dedupe window same
3) observe dup metrics for 24h, if dup_rate drops -> flip global aggregator to prefer composite fingerprint
4) if ordering issues, temporarily increase dedupe window and backpressure tuning

maria: created PR #3421 to add route_tag at ingress and update fingerprint fn. linked in thread.
billing-bot: PR #3421 merged to staging by maria — checks passed :white_check_mark:
aj: console change: add a column "routing tag" to invoice debug view and a tooltip: "routing tag used by edge/proxy to select serving cluster. influences metering fingerprinting and dedupe semantics."
kevin: also add an internal rule in rollouts UI: when rolling routing config changes, surface a warning that billing dedupe/fingerprinting may need sync. save teams from surprise invoice noise.
sarah: low-friction: add a console banner on dedicated/private for 48h after any router version bump that affects headers.
devon: alerting: create a slack-alert (not pager) for billing.dup_rate > 0.5% for > 15m, then escalate to ops if >1% for 1h.
kevin: +1 on slack-first. no pager for initial noise.
maria: I'll also schedule a backfill job to populate route_tag_hash for the last 7 days so aggregator can dedupe historical duplicates when we flip. can run incremental to reduce load.
ops-bot: scheduled job billing-backfill-route-tag starting 2025-04-02T02:00Z across eu-west and na-east shards.
kevin: timeline?
maria: canary EU-W this afternoon, run 3h smoke, then NA canary tonight. if green, start global roll by tomorrow morning. I'll post results in #eng-platform.
aj: thanks — once PR lands please add a tiny runbook for SRE on how to rollback aggregator fingerprint version and how to re-run backfill.
maria: will do.
aj: :thumbsup:
kevin: leaving a note: long-term we should standardize a per-event `metering_key` upstream in the proxy spec so clients can rely on deterministic invoicing across routing changes. separate RFC.
sarah: seconded.
maria: thanks team — will update thread with metrics after canary. :rocket:
